title: Square Hammer — Ghost
note: Hand-authored edits applied on top of the imported score at load. Survives re-import. See applyOverrides in player_common.js.

ops._comment: Drop the snare on beat 1 (leaving crash+kick) in the four-open-hi-hat bars. Beat-1 chord was crash+snare+kick in each.

Let-ring ties (Solo 1). A crash struck WITH a kick rings into the next lone crash, which is not re-struck — tie the two so the second reads as held, not played. The crash glyph is shared key a/5/x2 so crashcymbal and crashcymbalb tie to the same line.
Pair 1: m84 last 8th (crash+kick) rings into m85 beat 1 (lone crash). Crosses the bar line; arc lifted to clear m85's measure number.
Pair 2: m85 '+ of 2' (crash+kick) rings into m85 beat 3 (lone crash).
Pair 3: same shape as m84 — m100 last 8th (crash+kick) rings into m101 beat 1 (lone crash). Crosses the bar line.
Pair 4: m124 last 8th (crash+kick) rings into m125 beat 1 (lone crash). Crosses the bar line.
Pair 5: m126 last 8th (crash+kick) rings into m127 beat 1 (lone crash). Crosses the bar line.
